task:
Audit defect "CI's WebKit (iOS engine) screenshots after tab changes show the bottom nav missing or see-through" (criterion 5). First find out whether this is only the screenshot helper (captureScreen in e2e/support.ts firing mid view-transition or mid-animation) or a REAL rendering bug in WebKit: download the latest green CI run's artifacts on main (`gh run list --branch main --workflow CI --limit 3`), look at the WebKit Train/Coach/Progress/Profile screenshots and the Chromium ones with the Read tool, read the nav and view-transition code, and test locally on WebKit with captureScreen waiting for `document.getAnimations()` to settle and for no active view transition. If it is only timing: make captureScreen wait (and note it in the PR). If the nav really disappears or turns see-through in WebKit after a tab change: fix the UI (that is then the PR's main change) and add an e2e assertion that the bottom nav is visible and opaque after each tab change on both engines.
Intent: screenshots of every tab show the settled screen with its bottom nav on both engines, and the nav never disappears after a tab change

Audit defect "Today and Train tell a signed-in owner that setup 'opens with passkey sign-in · Soon'" (criterion 5). Passkey sign-in exists now. Reword both rows to the real next step in calm, premium product copy (e.g. "Training profile · Coming next"); copy-only, matching docs/design-system.md voice; update any e2e text assertions.
Intent: Today and Train describe the real next step, not a feature that already shipped

Two audit findings (criterion 8): (a) "The e2e server log is never uploaded from CI": .e2e-server.log is a hidden file, so upload-artifact skips it; fix with `include-hidden-files: true` on that step or by writing the log under test-results/ (pick the cleaner; keep local behaviour and docs consistent). (b) "Pushes to main cancel each other's CI runs": with `cancel-in-progress: true` a second merge to main cancels the first merge's run, so some merges are never tested on main; make it `cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}`. One PR, subject like "ci: keep the e2e server log and let every merge to main finish its run".
Intent: every merge to main gets a complete CI run, and failed e2e runs ship the server log

Audit info finding (criterion 8): "CI actions target the deprecated Node 20 runtime". Bump every action in .github/workflows/*.yml (checkout, setup-node, cache, upload-artifact, pnpm/action-setup, anything else) to its current major that runs on Node 24. Verify each version exists and its breaking changes do not affect our usage: read the release notes with `gh api repos/<owner>/<action>/releases --jq '.[0:5][] | .tag_name+" "+.name'` and the action's README for changed inputs (e.g. upload-artifact hidden files, cache keys). This PR's own CI run is the test.
Intent: CI runs on actions supported on Node 24 with unchanged behaviour

Audit finding (criterion 2): "Profile services run concurrent queries on one pg client" (node-postgres warns this is deprecated and will throw in a future version; inside a transaction, concurrent queries on one client are also unsafe). Find every place that issues queries concurrently on one client/transaction (Promise.all over the same db/tx in src/lib/server/services and repositories), make them sequential (or use the pool, not a single client, where that is what is meant), and make the test run fail on that deprecation warning so it cannot come back (e.g. a vitest setup that turns that specific process warning into a failure). Show the warning before and its absence after.
Intent: no code path issues concurrent queries on one pg client, and the tests fail if one does
